verdict.rationale: Nitrokey's own product pages say the key supports one-time passwords for website login, and that the Nitrokey 3 includes one-time passwords among its features, so the core capability is documented. The evidence is only marketing-level, so the depth of support is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit TOTP vs HOTP support, slot count/configuration docs, challenge-response mode, setup documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, the key covers legacy one-time-password schemes — TOTP/HOTP slots or challenge-response — for services that still lack WebAuthn

citations.quote: Login to websites (e.g. Google, Facebook) using secure One Time Passwords (OTP), U2F or ordinary static passwords.
The Nitrokey 3 combines the features of previous Nitrokey models: FIDO2, one-time passwords
